recommendation: Keep the seed audit as-is: maintain device-commercialBrand in the FHIR Extension Pack and do not restore a core extension source file for FHIR-27765.
issue_request: FHIR-27765 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested a DeviceDefinition.extension-commercialBrand extension, 0..1 string, defining the overall name of a collection of branded devices that an organization brings to market.
initial_application: Core commits c68a584f80751531e28540ddd2e588e314582e67 and 47a403241ab4707a77ad1e407bf5b9bcda54be18 added the extension and DeviceDefinition context. Commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 later removed the core extension source during the R5 extension-source move.
additional_context: The current Extension Pack defines device-commercialBrand with DeviceDefinition context, max 1, and string value. FHIR-47605 later limited that extension through R5 and directs R6 users to Device.name.type or DeviceDefinition.deviceName.type; the related FHIR-47605 result in this run adds the missing current-core commercial-brand-family name type.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit for the seed. Re-adding the R5 extension source to core would duplicate the Extension Pack artifact and conflict with current extension ownership.

related_jiras.note: Original question on specifying device brand was answered by creating the FHIR-27765 extension.
Later published decision limits device-commercialBrand through R5 and moves R6 representation to Device Name Type.
